en-US.description: Turns scanned documents (TIFF, JPEG, PNG, PDF) into very small, sharp and optionally searchable PDF files using Mixed Raster Content - GUI and command line.
en-US.longDescription:
MRC PDF Kompressor converts scanned images into compact PDF files using
Mixed Raster Content (MRC): the page is split into a high-resolution text
mask (generic JBIG2 by default - pattern-safe, without symbol coding or
character substitution; optionally CCITT G4, or maximum compression
with symbol matching), separate colour
text layers for stamps and headings, and a smoothed, downscaled background
(JPEG 2000 or JPEG). Typical results are 90-95 % smaller than the original
scan while the text stays crisp. Optional text recognition (OCR, runs
locally) adds an invisible text layer so the PDF becomes searchable.
Coloured or slightly tinted paper is detected and cleaned to an even area
in its own colour, and photos on text pages are kept as separate images
while the surrounding text stays sharp. Grey-shaded form fields are kept
with crisp edges, forms with coloured frames stay small text pages, and
screenshots on text pages are protected as images. On image pages
(photos, plans), reliably detected black text is kept in a sharp text
mask as well.
It also converts PDF files (e.g. from copiers) into small, searchable
PDF/A, keeping existing text, links and bookmarks.
Supports PDF/A-1b, -2b, -2u, -3b, -3u and PDF/A-4 output (validated with
veraPDF), multi-page TIFF, batch
processing of folders, custom profiles and a modern GUI with live
preview. The command line is fully scriptable (exit codes, progress,
profiles). Free for private individuals and small businesses (PolyForm
Small Business License).
en-US.name: MRC PDF Kompressor
